values: 一个贪吃的法师，能为友军提供治疗和增益效果。
A Hamster Mage who is passionate about food, and providing healing and bonuses to nearby allies.
猜猜漫漫今天带来什么好消息？
Anyone need Hammie to do some magic?
来见识一下漫漫的咒语吧！哒哒哒~
Acorns and fire magic! That's what makes me super cute!
谢谢大家对漫漫的支持，爱你们哦~
Merlin will definitely praise me for this!
要是能戴上戒指的话，没事没事啦！
If I can just put on the ring... Huh? Oh! It's nothing, I'm fine!
我的脸颊毛毛的最近有些干枯，代别的毛热热了吗？
The fur on my cheeks have been looking kind of dry lately... Hm hm~ There. Nice and fluffy, right?
哦，蹲虾，蹲虾，哦，不是我的橡果。
Wait, what's that bird got in its beak!? Oh good, it's not one of my acorns.
嘿嘿，这是梅林送的礼物，一定要好好珍藏！
Hehe, any gift from Merlin must be treasured!
送给我的？！这、这怎么好意思呀……！
A gift for me?! How can I accept such kindness?
I've come up with a new magic!
“第三届仓鼠魔法大赛，举办者：漫漫，参赛者：漫漫，获胜者：漫漫。”——神秘屋内，某张字迹娟秀的废纸条上书。
"The Third Hamster Magic Competition: host - Hammie, participator - Hammie, winner - Hammie." —A neatly written note on a piece of scrap paper
“成为梅林大人最倚重的仓鼠使魔”——漫漫的笔记本扉页上这么写着。
"Become Magister Merlin's most reliable hamster familiar." —Written on the title page of Hammie's notebook
漫漫的体型、力量各方面都比其他仓鼠使魔要弱小，但梅林并不认为她是残次品，并给予了适合她的工作。
Hammie is smaller and weaker than an average hamster familiar, but Merlin never sees her as a hindrance and assigns tasks that are suitable for her only.
仓鼠使魔里会说满满是笨蛋的只有漫漫，其他使魔曾以为这是一句魔法咒语。
Among all the hamster familiars, only Hammie calls Chippy an idiot repeatedly like it's a chant. All the familiars believe she cast a spell on him.
就算梅林在场，漫漫恐惧时还是会下意识地躲到满满的身后，为此漫漫总是让满满离自己远些。
Even in Merlin's presence, Hammie would hide behind Chippy subconsciously when frightened. To avoid this, Hammie always asks Chippy to keep his distance.
漫漫有一间密室，里面摆满了梅林的“周边”。废草稿，衣服，笔，甚至还有喝过的酒瓶。
Hammie has a secret chamber full of Merlin-related items, from written drafts to clothing and pens to empty bottles.
某次战斗中，梅林送给漫漫的帽子被吹下了悬崖，她毫不犹豫地跟着跳了下去，幸好帽子和她都被枯枝挂住了捡回了一条命。
During one battle, the hat Merlin had gifted Hammie was blown down a cliff by the wind. She jumped down without thinking. Fortunately, she survived.
帮助漫漫修补帽子的多莉是她除了梅林以外关系最好的朋友，她们经常举行茶话会，谈论这座神秘屋的主人。
Dolly, who fixes Hammie's hat, is her best friend other than Merlin. Together, they hold tea parties where they would talk about the master of this Mystical House.
“不管她有多强大，我都会作为骑士，站在前方守护她。”——满满。
"No matter how strong she becomes, I'll be the knight that stands in front of her to keep her safe." —Chippy
漫漫曾经抱着纠结的心态，试着让别的仓鼠使魔学习魔法，但是没有仓鼠学得会。漫漫因此偷偷地感到开心。
With mixed feelings, Hammie once encouraged other hamster familiars to learn magic, but none of them mastered any spells, which made Hammie secretly happy.
说起来，最开始见到阿尔萨时，我吓了一跳呢！就看到一个球形从远方向我们滚来……
Honestly, when I first laid eyes on Alsa rolling towards us from a distance, I was scared...
漫漫 & 满满 & 阿尔萨 & 索恩
说到吃的话，沙漠里的旅人树果还不错……噜噜呢？有爱吃的食物吗？
Speaking of food, the wanderfruit growing in the desert is quite tasty... Lumont, what do you like to eat?
满满 & 噜噜 & 漫漫
你们感受到了吗？刚才刮过来一阵清凉的风。
Did you feel it? A refreshing breeze.
漫漫 & 阿尔萨 & 索恩
对了对了，有件事我一直没问呢，之前偷走我项链的小偷到底是谁？
Hey! I haven't had a chance to ask until now... So, who stole my necklace?
萨忒娜 & 漫漫 & 瓦尔克
萨忒娜，你的预言能力好厉害，究竟是怎么做到的呢？是一种魔法吗？
Satrana, you're a powerful prophet. How do you do it? You know magic?
卡卡，看起来帕托和你相处很好呢，它凶不凶？
Koko, you seem to get along with Patto. Is he aggressive?
漫漫 & 卡卡 & 安丹德拉
有人说，要把趁手的好枪当做恋人。
I heard folks talkin' about treatin' good guns like lovers.
瓦尔克 & 漫漫 & 萨忒娜
It's so damp here, but we are by the sea after all...
嗯，说真的，你们来得不是时候。
Well, to be honest, your timing couldn't have been worse.
和水有关的魔法……唔，好奇怪，我明明记得这本笔记上有记录的呀……
Water magic... hmm, that's odd. I remember there being a note about it in this book...
自从锈锚港封锁后……我就会定期来海边逛逛。
Since Rustport got blockaded, I've been coming to the shore almost every day.
空气里的火药味好重啊……
The smell of gunpowder is so strong here...
满满 & 漫漫 & 辛巴达
有句话怎么说的来着？“欲言又止时，就像吞了只蜥蜴，却留了截蜥蜴尾巴在嘴边……”
What's that saying? "Holding back your words is like swallowing a lizard but leaving its tail hanging out of your mouth..."
辛巴达 & 满满 & 漫漫
魔法师大人，为什么盯着我的铁头瞧？
Master Mage, why are you so fixated on my Hardhead?
呼金 & 漫漫 & 满满
Wow, this smoked fish is delicious!
小水村的遭遇真是令人难过。我们能不能帮忙做点什么呢？
The situation in Brineville is really heartbreaking. Is there anything we can do to help?
主人，漫漫，你们有看到吗？
没有人来过小水村，见到我的妈妈们后不好奇的，想问就问吧！
No one who's visited Brineville and met my mothers hasn't been curious. Feel free to ask if you want!
魔法能让人死而复生吗？
Can magic bring people back to life?
索尼娅 & 满满 & 漫漫
满满捡到了很多漂亮的羽毛！
Chippy found a lot of beautiful feathers!
满满 & 索尼娅 & 漫漫
我说，你干嘛拿着两片叶子来回看？在找不同？
I'm wondering, why are you examining those two leaves so closely? Are you trying to find differences?
辛巴达 & 漫漫 & 路过的荧荧花
说实话，我也不是没出过海，但这次的冒险也太不一样了！
I've been out to sea before, but this time just hits differently!
辛巴达 & 漫漫 & 满满
嘻嘻，才不给你呢，这是给索尼娅姐姐的！
Haha, I'm not giving it to you! It's for Sonja!
奈拉 & 满满 & 索尼娅 & 漫漫
我小时候当过乞丐、小偷、扒手。甚至为了一口面包，和野狗打架。
When I was young, I was a beggar, a thief, and a pickpocket. I even fought stray dogs for scraps of bread.
索尼娅 & 漫漫 & 满满
Ugh! This... This makes me sick!
满满被扣在旅馆里的时候，听到了一些锈锚港本地流传的鬼故事。
Chippy heard some supernatural stories circulating in Rustport while I was locked up at the inn.
满满，你从哪里又买了一把剑？
Chippy, where did you get that sword from?
你们知道，之前的绿水村是什么样的吗？
Do you know what Greenbrook used to be like?
索尼娅 & 漫漫 & 满满
漫漫，你能不能帮我研制一些可以驱逐亡灵的魔法药水？我想涂在剑上！
Hammie, could you make some Graveborn-repellant magic potion for me? I want to apply it to my sword!
死潮舰队留下了很多实验记录，简直是骇人听闻……
What's inside the experimental notes of the Dead Tide Fleet is downright horrifying...
死潮舰队留下的实验记录，真是越看越让人心惊……
The more I read the experimental notes of the Dead Tide Fleet, the more unnerving they become...
唔——唔哇啊啊！不管是什么，快出来！满满才不怕你！！
Ah!!! Woah!!! I don't care what you are, just show yourself right now! Chippy isn't afraid of you!
自从死潮舰队的人踏上锈锚港的那一天，我就等着把他们斩杀殆尽的这一刻。
Since the day the Dead Tide Fleet disembarked at Rustport, I've been waiting for this moment to wipe them out.
卢卡先生，你这条腰带好精致呀。
Mr. Lucca, that's a beautiful belt you have there.
你既然得到了索尼娅的认可，我也会尊敬你。
Since you've earned Sonja's recognition, you'll also have my respect.
你们知道，我不是个诚实的人……
索尼娅，击败死潮舰队，锈锚港恢复平静之后，你有什么计划呢？
Sonja, peaceful days have returned to Rustport after you defeated the Dead Tide Fleet. What's next for you?
法拉莫尔先生，祭典结束以后，你会一直留在雪松镇吗？
Mr. Faramor, will you be staying in Cedartown after the festival is over?
漫漫 & 法拉莫尔 & 满满
这本书里记录了一些古老的咒语，使用了诸神时代的圣书文字，有几个字我实在无法辨认。
This book of ancient spells is written in the language of the old gods' era. There are some characters I can't recognize.
冬日祭典好棒啊！我还是第一次堆这么大的雪人！
This festival is so fun! I've never built such a huge snowman before!
真没想到，白山的活死人竟然是死神大人为了对抗恶魔而创造的亡灵战士。
The undead here are actually warriors created to subdue the Hypogeans—who'd have known?
格尔达女士，这次的“鬼影密室”是你设计的吗？
Madam Gerda, is the Ghostly Getaway your brainchild?
满满 & 格尔达 & 漫漫
洛桑，你怎么会跑到这里来打工呢？
Lorsan, how did you end up working here?
漫漫 & 洛桑 & 满满
等打工结束我就准备离开白山，又得头疼接下来该去哪儿游历的问题了。
I'm planning to leave Whiteridge as soon as my job is done. It's time to think about where to go next.
洛桑，满满很好奇，你变成雪人的时候有什么感受？
Lorsan, Chippy's curious—what was it like being a snowman?
满满 & 洛桑 & 漫漫
瓦丽卡？你刚才在温泉里泡了好久，我和梅林有点担心，温泉泡太久很容易头晕的。
Valka, is that you? You were in there so long that we got a bit worried. Soaking too long can make you dizzy.
漫漫 & 瓦丽卡 & 满满
哎，被你们这么一问我才意识到，我有快十年没有回部族去看看了。
Ah, now that you've mentioned it, I just realized it's been nearly a decade since I last visited home.
夕菊、异香草、橙花、响铃花的种子……
Evening chrysanthemums, aromagrass, orange blossoms, and bellflower seeds...
这种雕刻纹样我肯定在哪本书上看到过……
I must have seen this pattern in a book before...
休息……锻炼……休息……锻炼……休息……锻炼！
Rest... Train... Rest... Train... Rest... Train!
无论来这里多少次，我都还是会被这样的美景所震撼。大片的花，掩映在花丛中的古老遗迹，清澈的河水，远处的雪山……

The scenery here never fails to enchant me, no matter how many times I've visited—the sea of flowers, the ancient ruins hidden among them, the clear water, and the snow-capped mountains in the distance...
咦，柳博米尔？！你怎么会跑到这里来？
寒冷、肃穆、嘈杂和寂静的完美结合……白山的冬天总是会让我想起第一次神魔战争的时候。
The perfect combination of cold, solemnity, clamor, and silence... Winters in Whiteridge always bring me back to the First Divine War.
听杨凯维奇修士说，白山修道院的修士和修女早晨四点半就要起床！
Callahan told us the acolytes at the Whiteridge Temple have to get up at four-thirty in the morning every day!
白山好冷啊！风就像刀子一样，吹得我的脸又冷又痛。
It's freezing in Whiteridge! My cheeks are numb and sting from the wind.
请允许我再次多谢各位的馈赠。那株冰蓝灵蔓根对我的画来说意义重大。
Once again, I'd like to express my gratitude for your generosity. The blue spiritroot plays a crucial role in my painting.
好香啊，茶壶先生泡的茶闻起来有股花的香味……
Smells great! Mister Teapot's tea always carries a floral scent...
矮人的酒太烈了！闻着头晕晕的……
It has such a strong flavor...
漫漫 & 满满 & 霍根
主人，满满觉得这里的矮人对魔法师的态度好奇怪！
Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?
巨矿祭，锤击节，锻炉庆典，酒桶狂欢日……
Ore Festival, Hammer Day, Furnace Celebration, Barrel Bonanza...
村子里的矮人工匠看起来非常繁忙呢……
The craftsmen in the village seem completely swamped...
主人，满满从湖边带了好吃的回来！
主人，满满没想到，深岩村竟然在这么高的地方！进出都得坐升降机！
Magister, Chippy didn't know Brimstone Village was so high up! We actually need to take a lift to get there!
你好呀小姐，我叫漫漫，是<style="highlight"><player_name></style>的使魔！
Hello, miss! I'm Hammie, <style="highlight"><player_name></style>'s familiar! Pleased to make your acquaintance!
哇！主人，你终于公开身份啦！
Woah! Magister! You finally revealed your true identity!
满满，你手里拿的是什么？
咕噜噜……好凉好甜！这杯魔法冰饮里有好多小气泡，喝下去咕嘟咕嘟在肚子里炸开，好像在放小烟花！
Glug glug... Aaah! This magic icy drink is bursting with fizzy bubbles! It's like tiny fireworks are popping in Chippy's stomach!
与堕神的决战竟然这么艰险……真是难以想象！
The battle against the fallen goddess must've been so harrowing! I would've been so scared!

说起来，科丝蒂小姐应该是正式经受过培训的魔法师吧？
咒语和研究方法看起来都很专业。

Miss Cassadee, you must be a properly trained mage.
Your spells and research methods look very professional.
漫漫 & 科丝蒂 & 维伦
唔……肚子饿了。漫漫，你那里有什么好吃的？
Ugh... So hungry. Hammie, do you have anything to eat?
满满 & 漫漫 & 维伦
最近的天气好干燥，我的绒毛都炸开成一团了……
It's been so dry lately. My fur is making me look like a fluff ball...
致谢……嗯，感谢梅林大人的指引……
Acknowledgments... Hmm... I want to thank Magister Merlin for his guidance...
你们这里的布置……很有设计感啊。
Wow, these decorations are something else... really stylish.
布莱恩先生，我一直很好奇，你为什么总是戴着眼罩呢？
Mr. Bryon, just out of curiosity, may I ask why you always wear a blindfold?
漫漫 & 布莱恩 & 洛桑
卡夫拉 & 满满 & 漫漫
卡夫拉，你的剑术十分了得。
埃隆 & 卡夫拉 & 漫漫
薄暮丛林好神奇呀，能在让人不知不觉间获得平静。
The Dark Forest is truly magical. It feels like the forest is quietly bestowing tranquility upon us.
布莱恩先生，天空中正在飞翔的那个影子……是艾洛娜吗？
Bryon, that person soaring in the sky... Is that Elona?
薄暮丛林里能找到的美食真多啊！
There are so many tasty treats in the Dark Forest!
布莱恩的艾洛娜很漂亮哇，她的眼睛像宝石一样单良，羽毛也很润顺！
Bryon's companion, Elona, is so beautiful. Her eyes are as clear as diamonds. Her feathers are as smooth as silk.
漫漫 & 满满 & 布莱恩
这是纸鸢尾，这是绿黛兰……喏，漫漫你来闻闻，很香的。
This is an iris, and this is a green orchid... Here, Hammie, come. These smell very nice.
莱卡 & 漫漫 & 满满
唔唔，我脸上的毛毛是不是有点脏了呀……
Hmm, is there a bit of dirt on my face?
漫漫 & 满满 & 卢修斯 & 维伦
那——么，在闪耀的红宝石之下，打起精神来吧！
Under the ruby's shining hue, kindle the fervor, spirits renew!
唔，身上粘了好多泥巴……漫漫想洗澡了。
Ugh, I got so much mud on me... I think I'll take a bath.
<style="stress"><player_name></style>，我发现了一封请柬，信里邀请我们去宴会！
<style="stress"><player_name></style>, look! I found an invitation for a banquet!
漫漫，有喜欢的宝石吗？喜欢哪颗就拿走吧。
Hammie, do you have a favorite gem? Take whichever you like.
一、二、三！怎么样，这些够了吗？
One, two, three! How about this? Is that enough?
卢修斯 & 漫漫 & 满满
